text: Paying workers a share of incoming compensation pro rata to their reputation scores makes rigor self-enforcing, because workers who do not engage with the required care lose their spot in the reputation rankings and thereby lose their share of the job fee distribution.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: they sacrifice their spot in the rankings of reputation scores which affects their participation in the job fee distribution, which is paid out pro rata to the respective reputation scores.

value: applies to the ALE Platform fee distribution design
